title: Beauty Industry Trend Report - June 2026
description: From beach skin to mermaid waves and subtle shimmer, discover the beauty trends defining Summer 2026 and how brands can turn them into engaging social content.

blocks.x: TRENDS BEACH SKIN, GROWN-UP GLITTER, MERMAID WAVES
TRENDS BEACH SKIN, GROWN-UP GLITTER, MERMAID WAVES

Summer beauty is officially in session. This month's trends are about embracing looks that look lived-in, with hair and makeup that captures a vibe. Creators are gravitating toward beauty routines that look effortless, wearable, and distinctly summer. For brands, the opportunity lies in creating content that sells an experience as much as a product, tapping into the aspirational yet attainable rituals that are dominating social feeds.

The era of perfectly glazed skin is evolving into something a bit more relaxed. Beach skin captures the look of a day spent oceanside: bronzed cheeks, subtle freckles, soft radiance, and a hint of sunburn-inspired blush. Who What Wear says the trend “elicits images of beach days and flushed skin, sans the painful and itchy flaking that comes with the actual thing.” The look relies on lightweight complexion products, cream bronzers, and strategic blush placement to mimic a naturally sun-kissed flush. Creators and celebrities like Victoria Beckham are layering bronzer and blush across the nose and cheeks to recreate the effect of a day in the sun with tutorials emphasizing a healthy, protected, unfussy look.

Beach skin reflects consumers' growing preference for makeup that enhances rather than transforms. For brands, this creates opportunities to spotlight bronzers, blushes, skin tints, and SPF-infused complexion products.

Sparkle has made a comeback, but with restraint. Think champagne lids, subtle body glow, glossy highlights, and sheer washes of sparkle that catch the light without overwhelming the look. According to Byrdie, grown-up glitter is emerging as one of summer's defining beauty aesthetics, with creators like Tanem dedicating videos to the best shimmery makeup products.

The trend is also extending beyond traditional makeup. Brands like Fazit Beauty have helped redefine sparkle through their viral glitter freckles and temporary makeup patches, proving that shimmer can be playful, wearable, and social-first.

The glitter revival signals that consumers are looking for beauty moments that feel joyful and expressive without sacrificing sophistication. For brands, the opportunity lies in creating content that highlights small moments of self-expression that still feel attainable and elevated.

Summer's biggest hair trend is making a splash. Mermaid waves are soft, loose, textured hair that looks effortlessly air-dried after a day at the beach. The look embraces natural movement and subtle texture, delivering an undone finish that feels equal parts undone and aspirational. The trend reflects a broader shift toward low-maintenance beauty routines that prioritize healthy hair over high-maintenance styling. Salt sprays, wave-enhancing creams, and overnight braiding techniques are helping creators achieve the look without excessive heat, reinforcing the continued demand for effortless beauty.

Danielle Shanes shares a tutorial on heatless mermaid waves and routines that combine texture sprays, lightweight oils, and simple styling techniques to create soft, beach-inspired movement. The aesthetic has become a summer staple, pairing naturally with minimal makeup and sun-kissed skin.

June's trends point to a consumer looking for beauty that feels joyful rather than overly serious. Whether it's beachy skin, mermaid waves, or a touch of sparkle, consumers are embracing beauty that evokes a feeling - vacation, nostalgia, and carefree summer moments.
